name: numeric-conversion-test-6b3e1e5e00/invalid-decimal-as-byte-negative-255-p.bal
spec_references: ## Module-level declarations: Function definition; Supports required-params
## Expressions: Literal — Currently support `nil-literal`, `boolean-literal`, `numeric-literal` and `string-literal` only; Type cast expression
reason: The case expects a panic when explicitly casting decimal -255.0 to byte. Numeric literals, unary minus, explicit type casts, required function parameters, calls and local declarations are supported, with no restriction excluding decimal-to-byte casts or their out-of-range panic behavior.
test_design_notes: The // @panic marker asserts runtime rejection of the out-of-range cast.
